[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (67.2 → 70.8): Entering overbought territory, maintaining upward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (10.4122 → 10.4122): Continued strong expansion, signaling trend strengthening.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Upper $665.59): Breaking above the upper band, with a band width of 25.52% indicating increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($638.61): Support zone based on SMA100.
· Swing Resistance ($672.77): Resistance zone near the previous high.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low): Confirming continuation of the uptrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current Phase Diagnosis (Uptrend): Considering entry for a buy due to RSI entering overbought and MACD strong expansion continuing.
